description: Verify that DUT does NOT respond to an ICMP Information Request with an Information Reply — the Information Request/Reply pair (type 15/16) is obsolete per RFC 1122 §3.2.2.7 (SHOULD NOT)
approach:
[Objective]
The ICMP Information Request was an early way to discover an interface's network number; it has been obsolete since RFC 1122 (1989). Modern hosts must not reply, both to avoid leaking information and because the underlying assumption (no DHCP/RARP) no longer holds.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ICMP Information Request (type 15)

2. Observation (5 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: nothing — no Information Reply (type 16), no error message

[Pass condition]
DUT does not emit any response to the Information Request.

[Fail condition]
Fail_dut_replied — DUT emitted an Information Reply. Indicates the implementation still ships obsolete behaviour.

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently dropped the obsolete Information Request — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_replied: DUT emitted an Information Reply — obsolete behaviour still active
